User Story:
As a self-service restaurant operator, I want to deploy an advanced food recognition system so that customers can effortlessly identify and choose menu items using image-based interfaces, enhancing their ordering experience and increasing sales.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Achieve a food recognition accuracy rate of at least 90% for menu items.
- Ensure the system can process and display food images within 2 seconds of capture.
- Provide a user-friendly interface that allows customers to select items with a success rate of 95% or higher.

Test Outline:
- Conduct tests to evaluate the accuracy of the food recognition system against a diverse set of menu images.
- Measure the time taken from image capture to display of recognized items to confirm it meets the 2-second requirement.
- Monitor user interactions to assess the success rate of item selections made through the interface.
